# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/WeSpitfire/agent-merge-broker/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue containing exploitable details, credentials, lease tokens, or private
keys.

The supported trust model, credential handling, merge-authorization boundary, and hardening guidance
are documented in [`docs/SECURITY.md`](../docs/SECURITY.md).
